applicationFee.note: International fee $80; US citizens/permanent residents $65. Central exemptions: US military/veterans with documentation, previous UA graduate enrollees, qualifying UA undergraduates applying to same program next term with GPA3.0, UAH/UAB exchange students. Confirm international eligibility for an applicable category. Biology department itself cannot waive fees.

english.toefl: Central4.5 with no subscore below4; older department iBT80 minimum vs central79 before January2026
english.note: IELTS no band below6; DET no subscore below110. Test age under two years. Central exemptions require degree, at least two years coursework, or citizenship/legal residence in a recognized English-speaking country. Department FAQ implies English undergraduate study alone suffices; central eligibility is more specific, so confirm any exemption. International TAs undergo ITAP placement; department publishes older TOEFL speaking21 requirement.

documents: Transcripts (unofficial for application; official after admission)
Statement of purpose (main instructions1–2pages; FAQ1–3pages) describing background, goals, faculty fit and contributions
requirements.note: GPA3.0 required; biology or related discipline preparation assessed by advisor. Three letters from faculty familiar with academic/research potential. International records evaluated internally; WES not required. Funding decisions considered with admission, most fall decisions by March1. Generally no international admissions beyond March1 for fall/July1 spring due to visa lead time. Catalog also requires an interview with the prospective advisor before an application is complete.

funding.note: Funding depends on faculty advisor and TA/RA availability. Applicants automatically considered; department generally does not accept unfunded research-degree students, but this is not an unconditional all-admitted guarantee.
